_note: Feature map of fork additions on top of upstream (base 5134c05). One entry per user-visible feature. Text fields: caveman full style (see AGENTS.md). Add new entry per new feature; update files/commits when feature changes.

features.name: Lane title ellipsis toggle
features.description: Long lane titles stay one line with ellipsis instead of wrapping. Setting 'truncate-lane-titles', global + per board, default off. Edit mode shows full title.

features.name: Click outside saves card edit
features.description: Inline card edit and 'Add a card' form save on outside click, like Enter. Editor popups (suggestions, date pickers, menus, modals) ignored. Only one card in inline edit at once. Empty new-card form just closes.
features.evidence: In 2.1.0. User verified in Obsidian. Gap: pop-out windows not handled.

features.name: Same font size in card edit mode
features.description: Card editor uses var(--font-preferred-size) like rendered card, so text no longer shrinks on edit.

features.name: New note from card: open location
features.description: Setting 'new-note-open-in' (split right default, split below, new tab, same tab, new window). Ctrl/Cmd, Ctrl+Alt, Ctrl+Alt+Shift click override like Obsidian links.

features.name: New note from card: move card body
features.description: Setting 'move-card-body-to-note', default off. Text after first blank line moves into new note after template; card keeps title lines (line 1 becomes link) + parent:: lines. Shares splitFirstLine with feat-008.

features.name: Settings apply right away
features.description: Setting changes apply immediately; only save debounced, flushed on settings modal/tab close. Board settings save onto current board, not stale copy.

features.name: Parent and child cards
features.description: Child stores `parent:: [[#^id]]` pointing at parent block ID. Parent badge + children badge (n/m done). Hover parent badge highlights card, siblings, ancestors; hover n/m badge highlights card + all descendants. Menu: Add child card, Set parent..., Remove parent. Click n/m badge lists children by lane + archived, jump or check off. New child opens with room to type; empty or Escape removes it. Setting 'count-archived-children-as-done', default off.

features.name: Show only first line of cards
features.description: Setting 'show-first-line-only', default off. Title = all lines before first blank line (whitespace-only counts blank). Card with blank line shows only title plus faint ellipsis; rest in pop-up. Inline edit edits title lines only. No blank line: full card. Table view unaffected; search hit in hidden text shows full card.

features.name: Card pop-up editor
features.description: 'Open card' menu item opens card in Obsidian modal: editor, dates, tags, linked note. Esc, outside click, Ctrl+Enter save + close; autosave; saves find card by id. Setting 'open-card-on-click' (single click opens, 150ms wait so double-click still edits inline). Title bar ('List: name') + Windows-style buttons, tag footer (unique tags, '+N hidden tags'), fixed width near top, max 80% height. App hotkeys work inside (scope falls back to app scope). Ctrl+F opens editor search. Stays transparent until editor ready (class 'kanban-plugin__card-modal-preparing').
features.evidence: In 2.1.0; 206559c after 2.2.0. User verified in Obsidian.

features.name: Tag rendering fixes (Iconic + Obsidian rules)
features.description: Footer tags rendered through MarkdownRenderer so Iconic plugin icons/colors apply. Iconic icon sized 1em so tags keep text height. Number-only hashtags (#1) stay plain text, like Obsidian.

features.name: Search highlight
features.description: Footer tags highlight matched letters with mark.js like card text. Solid yellow mark, dark text, readable in light + dark themes.

features.name: Multi-select cards
features.description: Ctrl/Cmd+click or box drag on empty space selects cards. Right-click selected card: copy links, mark done, move to list, archive, delete. Drag selected card moves group. Del (Backspace on macOS) deletes selection, asks when more than one. Alt (Option) during drag copies instead; copied parent/child stay linked; same board only.

features.name: Red delete actions in menus
features.description: Delete items in card, lane and bulk menus shown red (setWarning), like Obsidian menus.

features.name: Drop at end of long list
features.description: Fix: card dragged to end of long scrolling list snapped back or landed one spot too high. Drop target keeps updating while list auto-scrolls. Card released below last card, inside list column (up to 200px below end slot), drops at list end. Outside board or between lists still cancels.
features.evidence: Root cause from user repro logs (6/15 drags lost target: frozen during auto-scroll, then card below 1-card end slot). Build OK, typecheck 41. User verified in Obsidian.
